channel.title: SRG+ Finance
channel.description: Updates of SRG+ Finance for Mac, downloaded outside the App Store.

item.description: - **Analytics lists follow the tile.** Money in shows who pays you most, Money out who you pay and what for, Owed to us who owes you most. - **Analytics keeps its numbers while it refreshes** and reads them first, so no more grey rows for seconds after a refresh or a company switch. - **Settings: your SRG+ Account and the Workspace page** on top, the same as in SRG+ CRM.

- **Sales in Analytics.** A second group of tiles under the money ones, read from your own Stripe through SRG+ Connect: New clients (and the ones who came back), Sales (plans and one-time, refunds taken out), Recurring (a month and a year, and what changed) and the Next 12 months. - **W in the period switch:** the last seven days. - No Stripe yet? The Sales tile says how to connect it in SRG+ Connect.
- Company pictures in the menu: each company shows its picture from SRG+ Connect (or its initials), in the switch, the chooser and at the top of the sidebar.

- **Update at the top.** When a new version is ready, a blue Update button shows at the top right of the window. One click installs it and reopens the app; without a click it still installs when you quit.

- Subscriptions: a payment plan can now have a last date. In New subscription or Edit, set **Ends**: Never, After a number of payments, or On a date. - **Charges** shows every payment still ahead up to the last one, and **Details** says how many are left and how much. - When a plan's last payment is done, it moves to Canceled and says **Ended**.

- **Updates install by themselves.** The app checks every hour and installs a new version when you quit it. Opened from the disk image or Downloads, it first offers to move itself into Applications, where updates can reach it. - **Directory** with Customers, Contractors and Vendors apart, vendor logos, and every subscription paid to a vendor. - Click a logo to change it. - Subscriptions no longer closes the app when you scroll.

**New: Subscriptions and Calendar**
- **Subscriptions**: every payment that repeats, in one list. Card charges are checked against the bank by themselves: paid, declined (and how many times), not seen, or a higher price. For the ones you pay yourself (rent, loans), a bill is made a few days before the date and goes to approval. - **Found in the bank**: charges that repeat but are not on the list yet. Add one in a click, or hide it. - **Calendar**: every date with money on it (subscriptions, bills, invoices, card due dates) by month, week or day, with the month's money in and out. You can also see these dates in Google or Apple Calendar through a private address, and turn it off at any time.

What's new since the last Mac download (0.1.0, November 6):
- Books: Review, Reconcile and month close, Reports, Chart of accounts, Rules, and Settings › Books. Review shows its first lines at once. - Banks: the bank accounts you connected in SRG+ Connect show in Finance, each with its bank's own logo. Settings › Banks lists them, with a Privacy Policy link. - Today: credit card due dates and minimum payments.
